sections.text: For the Sake of the World

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies Miasma for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 110. Blinds for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 10 seconds for one time only. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
-Applies Coercion Collapse (decreases all stats of the target by 30%, decreases the target's attack Ability accuracy by 20%, and reduces the target's HP recovery effects by 70%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000

[Filolial Queen] Fitoria or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
